items.title: Booked meetings are not the exposure that matters
items.whyItMatters: The activity log shows bookings, while the retrieved evidence suggests only attended meetings with a written plan are linked to lower readmission (claim c1).
items.opportunity: Read attendance and the written plan from the notes with a fixed abstraction form.

items.title: Confounding by case complexity
items.whyItMatters: Complex patients are chosen for meetings and are readmitted more, which reversed a crude estimate in a worked example (claim c2).
items.opportunity: Measure prior admissions, frailty, living alone and dementia from the discharge summary and adjust for them.

items.title: Reading every note is unaffordable
items.whyItMatters: Reading notes for all eligible discharges since 2023 would take several hundred hours against 120 available.
items.opportunity: Sample readmitted cases and two non-readmitted controls per case (claim c3).

items.title: Unequal access to meetings for working and carless carers
items.whyItMatters: Attendance depends on carers' work and transport (claim c5), so a policy of daytime meetings could widen gaps between families.
items.opportunity: Record whether the carer joined in person or by telephone and report results by area deprivation.

items.title: Two undated records with no usable methods
items.whyItMatters: A service evaluation and a conference abstract report favourable figures without methods or dates and cannot be rated.
items.opportunity: Do not cite them as support; contact the authors only if the local result is ambiguous.

errorsFound: The medical director's question treats a booked meeting as the intervention; the evidence points to the attended meeting with a written plan as the exposure to study.
reevaluation: The gaps favour sampling from outcomes: readmitted cases and non-readmitted controls with note-based exposure and measured complexity, rather than reading every discharge.
summary: Five gaps: exposure definition, confounding by complexity, reading workload, unequal carer access, and two unrated undated records.
